en: Dependent on an inferior state, an inferior state arises by way of root condition: dependent on one inferior aggregate, three aggregates [arise] …pe… dependent on two aggregates, two aggregates [arise].
Dependent on an inferior state, a medium state arises by way of root condition: dependent on inferior aggregates, mind-produced matter arises.

Dependent on an inferior state, both inferior and medium states arise by way of root condition: dependent on one inferior aggregate, three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise … [and so on] … dependent on two aggregates … [and so on] … Dependent on a medium state, a medium state arises by way of root condition: dependent on one medium aggregate … [and so on] …

Dependent on one aggregate, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter … dependent on two aggregates … at the moment of rebirth-linking … dependent on the aggregates, there arises the [heart-]base;
dependent on the [heart-]base, there arise the aggregates; dependent on one great primary … dependent on great primaries, there arise mind-produced matter, kamma-produced matter, and derived matter.
Dependent on a sublime state, a sublime state arises by way of root condition... [three].
Dependent on both a medium and a sublime state, a medium state arises by way of root condition: dependent on sublime aggregates and the great primary elements, mind-originated matter [arises].
Dependent on both an inferior and a medium state, a medium state arises by way of root condition: dependent on inferior aggregates and the great primary elements, mind-originated matter [arises].
The triad of the inferior should be expanded in full, similar to the triad of the defiled.
The triad of the inferior is finished.
